summary: cross-core lock for the shared SCB5 bus (IPC hardware semaphore, busy-poll, quiesce before unlock)
guideline: TESAIoT SDK (guideline only, never built): bento-firmware-template-mtb-only/bento_libs/claw/common/shared/include/ipc_scb5_lock.h (sema 16; mask+clear SCB IRQs before unlock, else the other core's ISR steals the transfer)
notes: needed only when both cores use SCB5 (e.g. CM33 OPTIGA + CM55 touch/LED matrix)
